title: Tab after typing a date must move to the next field, not jump back into the date field
status: Open since January 2019. The repository was archived, so no upstream fix will ship.
summary: Typing a date and pressing Tab fires change; Pikaday redraws and, one millisecond later, focuses the date field again, so the next field loses focus and the user's typing lands in the wrong place.
consumer: Author-written cabin booking form around the unchanged pikaday.js and pikaday.css at pinnedCommit (the head of the archived repository).
